task_definition.task_description:
Please check the current London time, then look for an Office 365 meeting room for at least 8 people on 2026-02-22 at 09:00. After that, check Alice’s availability for that date and archive the 09:00–10:00 availability as “Meeting Availability Archive” by email, then scan the living room devices, find the smart lock, and lock the main door with PIN 2026.

Then check MSFT, sell 5 shares, create a document titled “Office Security and Trade Execution Log” with the trade result and the tags office, security, and finance, get the first tag from that tag list, and then email “Order executed successfully” to facilities@company.com and trading-ops@company.com with the subject “Office Availability, Lock Security, and Trade Status.”

user_input.query: For user ops_user_17, please check the current time in Europe/London, then find an Office 365 meeting room for at least 8 people on 2026-02-22 at 09:00. Then scan devices in the living_room area, find the smart lock with ID lock_main, and lock the main door using PIN 2026. Next, check MSFT and sell 5 shares. Create a document titled “Office Security and Trade Execution Log” with the trade result and the tags office, security, and finance, then get the first tag from that list. Finally, email “Order executed successfully” to facilities@company.com and trading-ops@company.com with the subject “Office Availability, Lock Security, and Trade Status.”
